type RequiredFields<T> = T extends string ? { first: T; second: T } : never;
function first<T>(value: RequiredFields<T>): T {
  return value.first;
}
function requiredFirst<T extends string>(value: RequiredFields<T>): T {
  return value.first;
}
function fromArray<T>(value: T extends string ? T[] : T[][]): T {
  return value[0] as T;
}
function fromTuple<T>(value: T extends number ? readonly [T, ...T[]] : T[][]): T {
  return value[0] as T;
}
function accept<T>(value: (T extends string ? T[] : number) | Date): void {}
function acceptOrAny<T>(value: T extends string ? { first: T; second: T } : any): void {}
first({ first: 'left', second: 'right' });
fromArray(['left', 'right']);
fromTuple([1, 2]);
accept(['left', 'right']);
acceptOrAny({ first: 'left', second: 'right' });
type BranchChoice<T> = T extends string ? { tag: 'a'; pair: [T, T] } | { tag: 'b'; pair: [T, T] } : never;
function selectBranch<T>(value: BranchChoice<T>): void {}
selectBranch({ tag: 'a', pair: ['left', 'right'] });
